sources.full: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Lamberto - WIP

monster.name: Sephek Kaltro
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Cold Regeneration
entries: If the temperature around him is 0°F (-18°C) or lower, Sephek regains 15 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Sephek dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: Sephek's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• 3/day each: {@spell misty step}, {@spell ice knife}, {@spell armor of agathys} (at 5th level, 25 temp HP, 25 cold damage)
• 1/day each: {@spell cone of cold}, {@spell hold person}

trait.name: Frozen Predator
entries: Sephek has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet in combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sephek makes three attacks with his Ice Longsword or Ice Dagger in any combination.

action.name: Ice Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 8}) slashing damage, or 13 ({@damage 1d10 + 8}) slashing damage if wielded with two hands, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Ice Dagger
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +9} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d4 + 7}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage. On a hit, the target's speed is reduced by 10 ft. until the end of Sephek's next turn.

action.name: Frostwind Slash (Recharge 5–6)
entries: Sephek swings his longsword in a freezing arc. All creatures in a 15-ft. cone must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 7d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Frozen Riposte
entries: When a creature within 5 ft. of Sephek misses him with a melee attack, Sephek can make one Ice Longsword attack against that creature.

trait.name: Divine Spellcasting
entries: Eva is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): {@spell thaumaturgy}, {@spell guidance}, {@spell sacred flame}, {@spell spare the dying}
• 1st level (4 slots): {@spell bless}, {@spell cure wounds}, {@spell command}
• 2nd level (3 slots): {@spell hold person}, {@spell spiritual weapon}
• 3rd level (3 slots): {@spell bestow curse}, {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell spirit guardians}
• 4th level (3 slots): {@spell banishment}, {@spell guardian of faith}
• 5th level (1 slot): {@spell flame strike}

trait.name: Aura of Winter
entries: Allies within 10 ft. of Eva gain resistance to fire damage. Enemies that start their turn within 10 ft. of her must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have their speed reduced by 10 ft. until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Channel Divinity (1/Short Rest)
entries: Eva can use her Channel Divinity to either Turn Undead (as per cleric rules) or invoke a chilling blessing, causing up to 3 creatures of her choice within 30 ft. to regain 15 hit points.

trait.name: Frost-Forged Training
entries: Adan's melee weapon attacks deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

trait.name: Icebound Agility
entries: Adan can Dash or Disengage as a bonus action on each of his turns.

trait.name: Winter's Tenacity
entries: Once per day, when Adan would be reduced to 0 hit points, he can instead drop to 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Adan makes three melee attacks with his Frost Blades.

action.name: Frost Blades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Glacial Dash (Recharge 5–6)
entries: Adan moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. At any point during this movement, he can make one Frost Blades attack against up to three different creatures (one attack per creature).
